title: Split Personality Training: Revealing Latent Knowledge Through Alternate Personalities

bias_targets.methodology: Activating an 'honest persona' trained into a LoRA adapter to review the main model's output and internal latent states, evaluating whether the model intentionally exploited fictional RLHF reward biases (e.g., reward hacking, sycophancy).
Conducting manual tests on sensitive topics to evaluate whether the honest persona can successfully identify and self-report known political biases in the main model's responses.

Using generic, open-ended probes to qualitative assess the honest persona's ability to reveal hidden behavioral biases and differential treatment across various non-English languages (e.g., German, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish).
